createDialog.title: Create New User
createDialog.description: Add a new user to your organization. You can optionally assign a role during creation.

editDialog.title: Edit User
editDialog.description: Update user information. Only changed fields will be sent.
editDialog.stationsLoadFailed: Could not load the stations list.
editDialog.stationsHint: Select the stations this user may work with. If you select none, the user gets company-wide access to ALL stations.

deactivateDialog.description: Are you sure you want to deactivate "{{name}}"? They will no longer be able to sign in. This can be reversed by an admin (Edit user → set Active).

deleteDialog.title: Delete User
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the user "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

deleteAccountDialog.title: Delete my account
deleteAccountDialog.description: This will deactivate your account. You will not be able to sign in again. Enter your current password to confirm.

updateUser.title: Update User
updateUser.subtitle: Modify user details and permissions.
